feature: The knobs panel speaks for several copies at once
summary: Pick two or more copies of one component and the Component section stays on the panel and sets them together: one typed word renames five buttons, and one undo puts them all back. Picking a second copy used to take the whole section off the panel.
setup: Photonz Dev, Experiments window, release Next. Components, Library and Styles flags are on by default.

try.do: Open View ▸ Show Library and drag the Card tile onto the canvas three times: the first is the original, the next two are copies.
Click one copy, then shift-click the other. The Component section stays, headed "2 copies", with Title, Body and Picture.
Type into Title and press Return. Both copies take the words.
Press Command Z once. Both copies go back, not one.
Click one copy on its own, retype its Title, and switch Picture off.
Shift-click the other copy again: Title reads Mixed in its box, and the Picture switch has no position with Mixed beside it.
Press the Picture switch once. It turns on for both, the way a mixed checkbox always has.
Shift-click any layer that is not a copy. The section stays and says it is speaking for two of the three.

evaluate: Reading "2 copies. Editing the original changes them all.", is it obvious the rows below now set both?
Does Mixed in the Title box read as "they differ" rather than as a word somebody typed there?
Is a switch with no position and the word beside it clear enough, or does it just look off?
When a rectangle is picked alongside two copies, is the line about reaching two of the three worth its space, or noise?
Detach now turns every picked copy loose in one step. Is that what you expect from it, or should it stay one at a time?
rough: The mock is silent on all of this; the source is the several-picked-things rule in UX-PATTERNS §4, and this is the first feature built to it end to end.

The word beside the switch sits after the switch rather than after the knob's name. The rule's example puts it after the caption, but this panel's captions are a fixed 74pt column and "Picture Mixed" would truncate or shove the control out of line with every row above it.
Copies of two different components keep the section and one sentence saying why there are no knobs. Photographed as 2026-09-05-copies-share-knobs-9.png.

Detach used to grey out the moment a second copy was picked. That was a control that could have been made to work rather than a real constraint, so it now reaches every picked copy and the notice counts them.
The Layout section still vanishes on a multi-selection for exactly the reason the Component one did. Filed as its own task rather than fixed here.
Every picture here is a real screen capture of the probe app, not an offscreen render.
